scope: Official Wren SDK on local DuckDB; fixed SQL, no LLM, no platform HTTP or Docker.

cases.logical_sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount_cents)/100.0 FROM "order" o JOIN "customer" c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_internal=0

SELECT COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM "order" o JOIN "customer" c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_internal=0

SELECT c.customer_name,SUM(o.amount_cents)/100.0 FROM "order" o JOIN "customer" c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_internal=0 GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.customer_name ORDER BY 2 DESC,1

WITH m AS (SELECT substr(o.order_time,1,7) month,SUM(o.amount_cents)/100.0 amount FROM "order" o JOIN "customer" c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_internal=0 GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.month,COALESCE(m.amount,0) FROM "calendar_month" c LEFT JOIN m USING(month) ORDER BY 1

cases.logical_sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount_cents)/100.0 FROM "order" o JOIN "customer" c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_internal=0 AND o.order_time>='2025-02-01' AND o.order_time<'2025-03-01'

SELECT SUM(o.amount_cents-COALESCE(r.amount,0))/100.0 FROM "order" o JOIN "customer" c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id,SUM(refund_cents) amount FROM "refund" WHERE refund_status='SUCCESS' GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_internal=0
SELECT c.customer_name FROM "customer" c WHERE c.is_internal=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order" o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id AND o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0) ORDER BY 1
SELECT product_code,COUNT(*) FROM "product" GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT SUM(o.amount_cents)/100.0 FROM "order" o JOIN "customer" c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_internal=0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "order_item" i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" o LEFT JOIN "customer" c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL

SELECT SUM(o.amount_cents)/100.0/COUNT(*) FROM "order" o JOIN "customer" c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.is_deleted=0 AND c.is_internal=0
